body:
Reviewed PR #10 "plan: admit authored story cards without type migration" (riatzukiza/rheos, base 8581e0c → head 64cb9b5) end to end: all 7 full-diff pages read and individually assessed (240 insertions, 0 deletions across 5 files — a documentation/journal-only planning change: 6 receipt rows, a 49-line merge-evidence JSON, 41 ledger lines, a new 90-line task card, a new 54-line semantics note; no source, test, workflow, or config bytes changed).

Deterministic evidence: exact head, clean checkout, result success — all 10 gates exit 0 (diff hygiene clean; lint 0/0 with 8 pre-existing infos; 245 tests / 2261 assertions / 0 failures twice; 4 release builds 0 warnings; nonempty outputs). Green gates treated as tool evidence only.

Independent verification: the PR's core claims match the surrounding source — complete-graph admission currently accepts absent/task/epic and refuses `story` with `:malformed-card-type` (relationships.cljc:161-164, negative fixture at relationships_test.cljc:104); the notes' semantics table, epic-target rule, "no inferred type" behavior, nine-card count, and both resolvable cross-file links all check out; appended receipts use canonical UTC Z timestamps and the diff's zero deletions confirm append-only preservation. One candidate proposed and adversarially classified: ledger line 441's relative evidence link points at a nonexistent path — rejected as a defect because the same diff adds the working corrected link at line 454 with explicit disclosure, the change strictly improves link integrity versus base, and the only in-place cure would violate the repo's append-only journal law and falsify records added in this same changeset. Non-blocking notes: (1) the line-441 dead pointer remains a disclosed fossil of that append-only policy; (2) the PR body's binding head b4a7077 is stale versus actual head 64cb9b5; (3) external claims (Foresight refusal artifact bytes/SHA, native review/thread IDs, GitHub merge states) are unverifiable in this isolated checkout and show no evidence of falsity; (4) implementation RED/GREEN and native Ready are explicitly out of scope for this planning head.

Confirmed findings: none. No blocked invariants identified; deterministic gates and independent source cross-checks agree. Approve.
